payload.title: Both adapters scan non-spec helper and fixture files under __tests__ as product code, and only one emit site (the tenant-scoping raw-query rule) demotes a seed, bootstrap or fixture context, so a deliberately bare route in a test fixture is reported at full severity every night and the includeExcludedDir hook that is meant to express the choice has no effect.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:729-739 (collectTypeScriptFiles passes includeExcludedDir for __tests__ and excludes only .spec.ts, .test.ts and .d.ts files)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:713-723 (a second copy of the same options and the same isTestFile)
tools/aria-adapters/adapter-fs.ts:250-253 (includeExcludedDir is consulted only for a directory that is in the excluded set, so the __tests__ option never does anything)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:378-383 (isSeedOrBootstrapContext: the only demotion, matching seed, bootstrap or fixture in the path or the first 4000 characters)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:327-333 (the demotion is applied to the raw-query rule only; the unscoped-read rule at 343-366 always emits actionable)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:284-311 (mutation_missing_role_boundary and controller_missing_guard_boundary have no test or fixture context at all)
libs/backend-common/src/guards/__tests__/access-context.fixture.ts:97-107 (a fixture route with @Mutation and an @Access decorator only, the shape the rules flag)
payload.rule_violated: One predicate for 'this is test, seed or fixture code' shared by the adapters, so a finding about it is demoted or excluded in one place (PLAN-v2 section 1.2 one owner); a detector must not report a fixture's intentionally bare route as an actionable product defect.
payload.notes: access-context.fixture.ts declares routes with a single @Access decorator on purpose to test the guard. The security-boundary adapter walks it (it is under __tests__ and does not end in .spec.ts) and emits mutation_missing_role_boundary and controller_missing_guard_boundary rows for it on every run; those rows carry no confidence or actionability, so they cannot be told from product findings. In the 53-row sample read by the lead 7 rows came from this one file, while the 3 rows from a seed service were already demoted by the raw-query rule's own review_reason: the cost is sampler slots and judge calls spent on rows the adapter could have marked or skipped. Close condition: Move the test, seed and fixture-path predicate into adapter-fs.ts as one function used by every adapter, apply it to all emit sites (exclude, or emit review_required with a review_reason), and delete the no-op includeExcludedDir options; adapter tests that a fixture file under __tests__ yields no actionable finding for any rule. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
